item.title: Video shows 72-year-old’s arrest in Brentwood a week before her death
item.description: Brentwood police released body and in-car camera footage of officers arresting 72-year-old Yolanda Ramirez during a September family dispute; she died a week later.

item.title: San Francisco Superior Court strike ends, clerks to return to work
item.description: After striking for more than one day for the first time ever, the San Francisco Superior Court's clerks say they've reached a tentative agreement to end their strike. The agreement was reached Friday afternoon, officials with Service Employees International Union Local 1021 said. The clerks were demanding better wages, training and staffing. item.title: 2-year-old struck, killed near SF’s Oracle Park
item.description: Two people – including a 2-year-old – were struck by a car near San Francisco’s Oracle Park on Friday night, and the child died of their injuries.San Francisco Police Department officers were called just before 9 p.m. on Friday to the area of 4th and Channel streets on reports of the collision and found the child and an adult injured at the scene, according to a department statement.The two victims were taken to a hospital, where the child was declared dead. item.title: Several anti-war protests spring up around Bay Area
item.description: Several anti-war protests sprang up around the Bay Area and across the nation Saturday, less than 24 hours after the joint US-Israel strike on Iran.The overnight attack on Iran left hundreds dead, including the country's Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. The attack left many of Tehran’s 15 million residents attempting to flee the capital city.The anti-war demonstrators marched through the heart of San Francisco on Saturday afternoon. item.title: Neuroscientist says lasting weight loss requires ‘identity shifts,’ not just willpower
item.description: Losing weight — and keeping it off — can feel like an uphill battle, even with the growing popularity of weight-loss medications.A study from the National Institutes of Health found that 80% of Americans who lose a significant amount of weight regain it within five years. item.title: Santa Clara condo evacuated out of structural concerns
item.description: A condominium complex in Santa Clara was evacuated this weekend after officials found displaced concrete at the site but found no danger of imminent collapse, the city said Sunday.On Saturday just before 7 p.m., the Santa Clara Fire Department received reports of displaced concrete at the 56-unit Villa Bella condos at 1850 El Camino Real.
